coverage: Read native schematic, PCB, project settings, requirements and supplied check records.
Fresh native netlist export confirms /IN: J1.1–R1.1; /OUT: R1.2–C1.1–J1.2; GND: C1.2–J1.3.
Independently enumerated all five saved track segments: each is 0.25 mm, satisfying the 0.20 mm requirement. See review-work/physical/experiments/native-audit.json, track_width_check.

Inspected placement, closed 20 × 12 mm outline, OUT branch junction, capacitor ground trace, via and saved bottom-plane thermal connections. A sampled ground-copper route connects J1.3 to the via. See review-work/physical/experiments/native-audit.json, ground_fill.
Reran KiCad DRC with schematic parity; report arrays contain zero violations, unconnected items and parity issues. See review-work/physical/experiments/independent-drc.json.

Independently calculated the RC response and checked the supplied stimulus and measurements. Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/README.md and commands.json.

findings.condition: Apply the required ideal 1 V step at /IN with no external load and an initially discharged capacitor.

evidence.locator: Requirement 1: V(/OUT) at 1 ms must be between 0.62 V and 0.65 V
Line 1274: R1 Value="100k"; line 955: C1 Value="100n"
Line 256: R1 Value="100k"; line 107: C1 Value="100n"; R1/C1 pad net assignments
R1 IN OUT 100k; C1 OUT 0 100n; VSTEP PWL(0 0 1n 1)

findings.location: R1 value in the native schematic and PCB
findings.mechanism: R1=100 kΩ and C1=100 nF produce RC=10 ms. The unloaded response Vout(t)=1−exp(−t/RC) therefore reaches only approximately 0.09516 V at 1 ms.
findings.reasoning: The direct native values and independently confirmed connectivity predict a voltage below the required 0.62 V minimum. The recorded simulation agrees with the calculation. Its 1 ns input rise cannot explain this large discrepancy. Clean ERC and DRC results do not establish compliance with the response requirement.
findings.title: Saved R1 value causes the required 1 ms step response to fail

limitations: Zone fill was inspected as saved; no refill was performed. Sampled copper continuity does not establish resistance or impedance.
No hardware measurements, parasitic extraction, tolerance, temperature, loading, ADC sampling or EMI evaluation.
No ampacity or thermal qualification; track width alone was not treated as evidence of either.
No supplier part-rating verification, fabrication capability approval, production Gerber/drill audit, assembly testing or mechanical mating/enclosure evaluation.
Ignored ERC/DRC rule classes were recorded but not exhaustively independently verified. The DRC rerun shares the supplied check's KiCad engine.
The 5 ms response measurement has no declared acceptance bound.
